statements.quote:
Supplementary Materials: The following supporting information can be downloaded at: https://
www.mdpi.com/article/10.3390/jintelligence14080168/s1, Table S1: Generative AI Dependence
Scale; Table S2: Self-Report Creativity Scale; Table S3: Chinese Critical Thinking Structure Scale;
Table S4: AI Creativity Self-Efficacy Scale; Table S5: Outcome-Oriented Priming Statements; Table S6:
Process-Oriented Priming Statements; Table S7: Thinking Orientation Manipulation Check Items;
Table S8: Consensual Assessment Technique (CAT) Scoring Rubrics; experimental task instructions
for Studies 2 and 3.

Data Availability Statement: The original data presented in the study are openly available in the
Psychological Data Bank at: https://cstr.cn/31253.11.sciencedb.psych.01038 (accessed on 15 July
2026); https://doi.org/10.57760/sciencedb.psych.01038 (accessed on 15 July 2026).

deposits.repository: Psychological Data Bank / Science Data Bank (ScienceDB)
deposits.notes: Both the DOI and the alternative paper/form URL https://cstr.cn/31253.11.sciencedb.psych.01038 returned HTTP 200 and resolved to https://www.scidb.cn/detail?dataSetId=463279239c3c4c0693eaf85f94dfc752. The public landing-page Dataset JSON-LD explicitly reports conditionsOfAccess='EMBARGO', despite the paper's claim that the original data are openly available. No embargo end date was confirmed. No download or access request was attempted after identifying the embargo. Public DataCite metadata at https://api.datacite.org/dois/10.57760/sciencedb.psych.01038 returned HTTP 200 and reports '4 files' totaling 331547 bytes, version V1; the landing-page JSON-LD reports version 1.0.0. Filenames and individual sizes were not exposed in the retrieved metadata; its distribution/contentUrl fields do not provide file links. Thus files=[] means no filenames confirmed, not an empty deposit. The deposit is titled 'Generative Artificial Intelligence on Creativity: A Dataset from Four Sequential Studies' and names Liu Chunlei. Its description claims Study 1 N=142, Study 2a N=130, an additional Study 2b N=162, and Study 3 N=160 (total N=594). The saved published paper instead reports three studies, with S2 N=132 (PDF pp. 5-6). S1 and S3 appear to correspond by description, and Study 2a may correspond to S2, but the version/sample mismatch cannot be reconciled without inspecting files. These are metadata sample-size claims, not observed row counts. Participant-level structure, arm variables, scores, and AUT texts remain unverified.

deposits.repository: MDPI journal supplementary materials; PMC / Europe PMC mirror
deposits.notes: The paper (PDF p. 13) describes Tables S1-S8, comprising questionnaires, priming statements, manipulation-check items, CAT scoring rubrics, and experimental task instructions for Studies 2 and 3. It names no participant data file. The supplement URL and publisher landing page https://www.mdpi.com/2079-3200/14/8/168 both returned HTTP 403 Access Denied. The article DOI https://doi.org/10.3390/jintelligence14080168 also ended at HTTP 403 on that landing page. As an alternative source, https://www.ebi.ac.uk/europepmc/webservices/rest/PMC13514692/fullTextXML returned HTTP 200 and identifies the single named supplementary ZIP; https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC13514692/ returned HTTP 200 and links the same file. The file link https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/instance/13514692/bin/jintelligence-14-00168-s001.zip returned HTTP 200 with an HTML 'Preparing to download ...' proof-of-work bot check instead of ZIP content; stopped there without solving it. The independent Europe PMC endpoint https://www.ebi.ac.uk/europepmc/webservices/rest/PMC13514692/supplementaryFiles returned HTTP 200/application/zip, but in-memory retrieval attempts timed out or produced an archive that could not be read ('Bad magic number for file header'). No member contents were confirmed. n_files=1 counts the archive named in the public article manifest, not its unknown internal file count; size_bytes is null because a complete valid file size was not established. The paper's description suggests materials only, but contents and data-presence flags remain unconfirmed. The Study 3 instruction questions in final.open_items remain unresolved. The article's CC BY notice was not assumed to establish a separate supplement license.

notes: Checked on 2026-10-09. Read the complete 445-line markdown conversion, including end matter and references (all 15 PDF pages; no appendix in the saved PDF), and checked the availability statements against PDF pp. 3, 13, and 14. The three quoted availability/materials statements are reproduced from the PDF; no code-deposit or preregistration statement was found. The DOI and CSTR identify one data deposit and are not counted twice; the separately listed journal supplement is the second deposit. 'restricted' is used for the declared data embargo because the requested top-level status vocabulary has no embargoed value. Public metadata alone do not establish public participant data. No participant/output columns or rows were read, so no missing statistics can presently be computed from confirmed public data. In particular, the S3 analyzed cell counts and the process-oriented SDs/effect size flagged in final.open_items cannot be checked, and AUT diversity cannot be recomputed without participant texts/ideas and arm assignments. Searches found no confirmed alternative deposit; broad author queries were only partly enumerated and follow-up queries and access failures are recorded, so this is not proof that no other deposit exists. Only the requested JSON file was written; network responses were handled in memory.
